d:
This time on Guest in the Newsroom, our guest is actress Kajol — an artist known for her versatile performances, from Dushman to Kuch Kuch Hota Hai, and from Bekhudi to Kabhi Khushi Kabhi Gham. She opens up about her personal and professional life, sharing insights from her remarkable three-decade journey in the film industry. Watch Full episode to know more.
Produced by: Akash Singh
Video Editor: Shakir Khan
